# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This file contains instructions for GitHub Copilot to help guide code suggestions and completions within this project.

## Project Overview
This repository contains a collection of helpers and prompts for various AI coding agent tools including Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. Additional tools and helpers will be added as needed.

## Guidelines
- Follow the existing folder structure for organization
- Keep prompts and instructions clear and concise
- Document any new tools or helpers added to the collection
